## What Is AI Sales Pipeline?

AI Sales Pipeline is an autonomous AI sales pipeline platform — a software system that uses artificial intelligence to automatically capture, qualify, engage, and convert sales leads across text messaging, email, AI clone video, and 24/7 AI call answering — with human takeover at any time.

It is purpose-built for real estate agents, teams, and brokerages, with NEPQ and Brandon Mulrenin reverse-selling scripts pre-loaded — but the underlying autonomous-sales-pipeline architecture applies to any high-consideration B2C or B2B sales motion (financial services, insurance, home services, coaching, SMB B2B).

Unlike generic CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Follow Up Boss) which store data and remind humans to act, AI Sales Pipeline is an active operator: the moment a lead enters the system it begins working on its own — texting, emailing, sending personalized AI clone video, and answering inbound calls — within seconds.

Unlike sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo) which augment human SDRs, AI Sales Pipeline replaces the human follow-up entirely for the first 8-12 touches and the qualification work, handing over only qualified, booked appointments to the human agent.

## What Problems Does It Solve?

1. **Slow lead response** — Most agents take 2-3 hours to respond to new leads. AI Sales Pipeline responds in under 60 seconds via text, email, or voice call.
2. **Inconsistent follow-up** — Agents forget to follow up, get busy, or give up after 1-2 attempts. The AI follows up persistently across multiple channels for days or weeks.
3. **Lead loss to competitors** — 78% of leads go with the first agent who responds. AI ensures you are always first.
4. **High cost of ISAs** — Hiring an Inside Sales Agent costs $50,000-$67,500/year. AI Sales Pipeline costs $8,340-$11,940/year and works 24/7.
5. **Cold database leads** — Old leads sitting in a CRM going stale. AI reactivates them with personalized outreach campaigns.

## Core Features

- **AI Text Messaging (SMS)**: Two-way conversational SMS with AI that sounds human. 98% open rate. TCPA compliant.
- **AI Email Follow-Up**: Behavior-adaptive email sequences with open/click tracking. NEPQ psychology-based copy.
- **AI Call Answering (live)**: AI answers inbound calls 24/7, qualifies callers, and books appointments; every missed call gets an instant text back. Outbound AI calling campaigns are rolling out.
- **AI Clone Video**: Generates lifelike video of the agent (face, voice, mannerisms) personalized for each lead. Says their name and references their property interest.
- **Lead Scoring**: AI analyzes dozens of signals to rank leads as cold, warm, or hot. Real-time updates. Priority notifications.
- **Missed Call Text-Back**: When a call goes unanswered, AI texts the caller back within seconds with a personalized message.
- **NEPQ Automation Scripts**: Pre-loaded Neuro-Emotional Persuasion Questioning follow-up sequences built into every channel.
- **FSBO Automation**: Dedicated module for For Sale By Owner prospecting with NEPQ SMS and email sequences; power dialer and voicemail drops rolling out.
- **Expired Listing Automation**: Automated multi-channel outreach to expired listings starting the moment they expire.
- **Facebook Retargeting**: Automatic audience syncing to retarget engaged-but-unconverted leads on Facebook and Instagram.
- **Seller Lead Workflows**: Pre-built sequences for FSBO, expired, downsizer, and pre-foreclosure seller leads.
- **Buyer Lead Workflows**: Intelligent buyer qualification, IDX property alerts, and long-term nurture sequences.
- **Custom AI Brain**: Train the AI on your market, style, scripts, and objection handling for a personalized experience.
- **Pipeline Management**: Visual Kanban board tracking every lead from first contact to closed deal.
- **Appointment Booking**: AI qualifies leads and books appointments directly onto your calendar.
- **Reputation Management**: Automated Google review requests after closings. AI-drafted review responses.
- **Power Dialer (rolling out)**: Auto-dial contact lists at scale for FSBO, expired, and circle prospecting.
- **Unified Inbox**: SMS, email, and call activity in one conversation view; Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Google Business channels available via platform configuration.
- **Visual Workflow Builder**: Drag-and-drop automation with triggers, conditions, and if/then branching.

## Who Is It For?

- **Real estate agents** who want to respond to leads faster and never miss follow-up
- **Real estate teams** that need consistent follow-up quality across all agents
- **Brokerages** looking to standardize lead engagement and reduce ISA costs
- **FSBO specialists** running high-volume For Sale By Owner outreach
- **Expired listing agents** who need persistent multi-channel follow-up at scale
- **Solo agents** who want to compete with larger teams without hiring staff

## Pricing

All plans include unlimited contacts, unlimited users, and 24/7 AI automation.

- **Basic Plan**: $397/month — AI text and email automation, 24/7 AI call answering, pipeline management, workflow builder, review automation. Includes 2,000 AI text messages, 250 AI voice minutes, and 5,000 emails per month.
- **Pro Plan**: $695/month — Everything in Basic plus video email, WhatsApp, social DM automation, AI content generation (power dialer rolling out). Includes 5,000 AI text messages, 750 AI voice minutes, and 15,000 emails per month.
- **Elite Plan**: $995/month — Everything in Pro plus branded apps, API access, reseller mode, custom AI voice training, monthly strategy calls. Includes 12,000 AI text messages, 1,500 AI voice minutes, and 40,000 emails per month.
- **One-Time Setup**: $2,499 for Keller Williams (KW) agents; $4,000 for non-KW agents — Full system configuration, AI training, integrations, NEPQ script setup, and personalized onboarding
- **Usage add-ons** (optional, one-time blocks): 1,000 additional AI texts $69 · 250 additional AI voice minutes $89 · 10,000 additional emails $59. Contacts, users, and workflows are unlimited on every plan; the AI is never cut off mid-conversation.
- **Annual Billing**: Save 10-20% with annual plans
- **Money-Back Guarantee**: 90-day refund on setup fee if no measurable results

## Key Differentiators

1. **Real estate-specific** — Not a generic tool adapted for real estate. Every feature is built for agent workflows.
2. **60-second response time** — Research on lead response (MIT/InsideSales Lead Response Management Study) shows first-minute contact converts dramatically better than waiting even 5 minutes.
3. **NEPQ scripts pre-loaded** — Psychology-based follow-up sequences used by top 1% of agents. No training needed.
4. **All-in-one platform** — SMS, email, voice, landing pages, booking, CRM, reporting. No tool juggling.
5. **Replaces ISA** — 12-18% the cost of hiring a human ISA. Works 24/7 without sick days or turnover.
6. **AI Clone Video** — Personalized video of the agent generated by AI for each lead. No mainstream real estate CRM offers this today.
7. **7-14 day done-for-you build** — Team handles everything. Zero technical work required from the agent.

## Performance Metrics

- <60 second average response time to new leads
- 7-12 automated touches per lead across SMS, email, and video
- Speed-to-lead reporting (median and p90 first-response time) built in
- Designed to save agents 15-20 hours per week on manual follow-up
- $58,827/year savings vs. hiring an ISA (Pro plan comparison)
